# Which Boundary Would You Choose?

## Comparing Different Ideas

Not every boundary is equally useful.

| Boundary | Keeps Molecules Together | Allows Exchange |
|----------|:------------------------:|:---------------:|
| No boundary | ❌ | ✔ |
| Solid box | ✔ | ❌ |
| Flexible boundary | ✔ | ✔ |

> Which option seems best for something that must stay alive?
